com.vector.cfg.model.annotation

Interface IAnnotation

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IUserMessage, IViewedModelObject
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IUserAnnotation

    @NotThreadSafe
 @PublishedApi(value=CLASS_DEPENDENCY)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IAnnotation
extends IViewedModelObject, IUserMessage
    IAnnotation represents one actual annotation in the model. Each IAnnotation is hold by an IAnnotationAccessor and has one associated IAnnotationType.

    The IAnnotation is created with an creation IModelView. All method will retrieve and set data in the creationModelView. The creationModelView is copied from the IAnnotationAccessor.

      • getMdfObject

        MIObject getMdfObject()
        Returns the MIObject of this IViewedModelObject.

        Attention: The returned MIObject could be invisible in the current active IModelView! You have to check the visibility in the client side code!

        The method will never return null.

        This is the underlying annotation element of the MDF model, either an MIAnnotation or an MISdg.

        Specified by:
